description: Returns the workflow presets configured for the given company and tool.

parameters.name: filters[tool_type]
parameters.description: Workflow-enabled tool to return presets for (for example, `subcontract_invoice`).

parameters.name: filters[tool_subtype]
parameters.description: Subtype of the tool to return presets for.

parameters.name: filters[is_default]
parameters.description: When true, returns only the preset marked as default for the tool; when false, only non-default presets.

parameters.name: filters[is_valid]
parameters.description: When true, returns only presets free of configuration and external errors; when false, only presets carrying such errors. Omit to return presets regardless of validity.

valid.description: If true, this configured template is ready to use to generate an instance

default.description: If true, this configured template will be used by default for this tool

400.description: Bad Request. The tool type or tool subtype filter is missing or invalid.
